title: GoOrganicAfrica calculator readiness evidence batch 03
scope: Additional official catalogue and access-policy checks for Benin and Senegal. This batch adds source discovery and data governance facts only; no new numeric calculator inputs are certified.

countries.name: Benin

sources.title: INStaD Statistiques Agricoles
sources.findings: Official page lists the definitive 2023-2024 campaign results PDF (912.77 KB), 2023 macro agricultural indicators, and 2022 National Agricultural Census volumes including the main tables volume (37.49 MB) and main results volume (22.96 MB).

sources.title: FAO AGRISurvey Benin access-to-data
sources.findings: Links ESA 2024 interactive statistical tables and notes an October 2026 survey brief for agricultural season 2024/25.

sources.title: FAO ESA 2024 release
sources.findings: Confirms ESA 2024 has crop area, production, yield, agricultural input use and harvest/post-harvest loss information.

verified_facts: INStaD says annual area and production series are sourced from the Ministry's Directorate of Programming and Forecasting.
INStaD states yield is calculated as production divided by area, with conversion to the stated unit.
The INStaD 2023/24 report link returned HTTP 503 in this retrieval attempt; no crop-level values extracted.
The ESA 2024 Open Data for Africa link returned HTTP 403; no ESA 2024 table values extracted.
blockers: Retrieve INStaD campaign report and census tables using a working official download endpoint.
Extract crop area, production and yields by crop and region; reconcile survey/campaign definitions.
Obtain dated producer/farmgate prices and current input/labour cost evidence separately.

countries.name: Senegal

sources.title: ANADS EAA 2024-2025 catalogue
sources.findings: Official national record, survey identity SEN-DAPSA-EAA2024-2025-v1, reference period 2024-2025, DAPSA producer and 2026 anonymised version.

sources.title: ANADS related materials
sources.findings: Phase 1 and Phase 2 questionnaires, enumerator manual, and local-to-standard unit conversion workbooks for arboriculture, horticulture and rainfed crops are listed.

governance: Survey covers all 45 departments, but anonymised microdata replaces department with agroecological zone while retaining region.
Microdata is confidential; use is restricted to aggregated statistical outputs.
Microdata may not be copied or transmitted to other persons or organisations without prior written DAPSA authorisation.
Local measurement conversion workbooks should be used before yield or price comparisons.
blockers: Use public aggregate tables where available, or request DAPSA-authorised access before using microdata.
Do not publish department-level claims from anonymised agroecological-zone data.
Extract actual weighted aggregates and validate units, season, crop identity and sample quality.

safeguards: No raw confidential microdata was downloaded, stored or redistributed.
No crop values were invented or certified from a source announcement alone.
Neither country is calculator-ready; existing ten active profiles and calculator formulas remain untouched.
next_batch: Obtain the INStaD Benin campaign/census files via an alternate official route; for Senegal, extract public aggregate tables and apply official conversion tables, or seek written DAPSA authorisation for microdata.
